svg.text: The county with the most withdrawals has one of the lowest rates
Withdrawn or denied plans as a share of all resolved plans filed 2015-26, by county.
Denominator is CAL FIRE's permanent archive. Counties with fewer than 25 resolved plans are omitted.
Humboldt resolves 732 plans and loses 10 — 1.4%. Sonoma resolves 41 and loses 6, which is 14.6%.
Violet is the rate after removing withdrawals that name a replacement plan: those are refilings, not failures.
The retained withdrawal set may be incomplete, so every rate here is a lower bound.
